'''Tor'Oront''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==Description==
The population of Tor'Oront were almost all [[Elomin/Legends|Elomins]], and the settlement was named after a [[City/Legends|city]], [[Oront]], that was located on the Elomin [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. The buildings in Tor'Oront had basic ammenities, but were very similar to [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] habitations, such as those in [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
Tor'Oront was established during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when a con-artist from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] tricked a group of Elomin settlers into a form of indentured sevitude and forced them to mine [[madilon]]. Eventually, the Elomin rose up and were able to free themselves from their service to the con-artist. However, they were too poor to leave Nyriaan, so the planetary council agreed to let them stay.
